pages.contents: One landscape CARE Checklist of information to include when writing a case report. The red-headed table lists reporting topics and items 1 to 13 (title, key words, abstract, introduction, patient information, clinical findings, timeline, diagnostic assessment, therapeutic intervention, follow-up and outcomes, discussion, patient perspective, informed consent) with a Reported on Line column holding manuscript line ranges for every item. The informed-consent row shows a Yes box containing a check mark and a blank No box. The top of the page shows the CARE logo, a check mark beside a box, and a BY-NC-ND license badge.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Administrative reporting checklist with manuscript line references and a consent checkbox. It contains no individual history, test results, measurements, doses, treatment course or outcomes. Line-range cells are manuscript references, not patient clinical data.

limitations: Administrative manuscript-reference information does not constitute additional patient clinical data.
